thread:
Lina: heads up — spike in TLS rejects from ap-southeast-1 observed at 03:22 UTC. error in edge-proxy: "tls: handshake failure (remote error: handshake failure)" when connecting to model-ingest.
Raj: reproed on a host — server is presenting a cert signed with SHA1-RSA (wtf). I can see chain: leaf -> intermediate-legacy-selfsigned -> root. clients with tls-strict reject.
certbot: note: cert-provisioner logged: `SignOperationDenied: user=role/cert-provisioner-apac missing kms:Sign on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:222222:key/ef01-2345` at 03:19:58Z
Anya-Sec: hypothesis: RBAC prune removed kms:Sign from the cert-provisioner role in apac which caused the provisioner to fallback to a legacy self-signer for short-lived certs. That explains the SHA1/legacy sig. can we confirm an IAM change around 03:00?
Lina: I see PR #4321 rolled a policy tightening for several roles at 02:58 UTC. It targeted encrypt/decrypt/sign scope.
oncall-bot: alert: tls-handshake-rejects > 1% (ap-southeast-1). services affected: edge-proxy, model-ingest, trace-collector.
Raj: quick checks for ops: 1) list cert presented: `openssl s_client -connect model-ingest.ap-southeast-1.internal:443 -servername model-ingest -showcerts` 2) vendor TLS debug: `envoy --log-level debug` to see presented cert fingerprint.
Lina: rotator-bot logs pasted: ```
2026-03-23T03:20:05Z rotator ERROR sign failed: AccessDeniedException: Missing kms:Sign for key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:222222:key/ef01-2345
  at rotator/sign.go:88
```
Anya-Sec: mitigation options: A) revert the RBAC change for cert-provisioner in apac (restore kms:Sign) — fastest, B) rotate proxies to force use of cached valid certs (painful), C) temporarily relax TLS strictness (undesirable). Immediate: revert role in apac, gather kms audit entries.
Lina: applying rollback for role/cert-provisioner-apac now. will scope a tighter follow-up IAM that grants kms:Sign only on the signing key with condition on service=cert-provisioner.
Raj: after rollback, cert-provisioner successfully signed new CSRs and pushed ECDSA-signed leaf certs. handshake failures fell to baseline in ~2 minutes. Verified with `openssl s_client` (cert signature: ECDSA-SHA256).
Anya-Sec: post-incident actions: 1) Add an RBAC rollout checklist step to verify kms:Sign/kms:Decrypt for all cert-related roles in each region, 2) add automated test in CI that runs a TLS handshake matrix (ECDSA/RSA + TLS1.2/1.3) against staging after RBAC changes, 3) instrument key usage audit logs to include role and region tags and surface `SignOperationDenied` alerts. I'll own the audit dashboard.
Lina: creating ticket SEC-APAC-2026 for follow-up IAM policy hardening and CI test.
Raj: assigning follow-ups — @Raj will add the handshake test to the canary pipeline, @Anya-Sec will build the audit dashboard, @Lina will craft the scoped IAM policy and run the rollout canary.
certbot: note for release notes: rbac: rollback applied to restore cert-provisioner kms:Sign in ap-southeast-1.
Lina: thanks everyone — closing this thread once the follow-ups are scheduled. :lock:
